name: Alice
source:
The main character. Based off the titular protagonist from Carroll's [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i]. She falls down a rabbit hole into Wonderland as if having forgotten something very important.

Alice's goal is to find a way out of Wonderland, leading her to search for the Red Queen's pieces.

...Yet who is Alice?

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/bellhouse/who-is-the-red-queen/]official website[/url]]
